title.en: Liu Yuxi: a poet’s voice across provincial life
title.zh: 刘禹锡：地方生活中的诗人声音

location.label: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

labelI18n.en: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

summary.en: Liu Yuxi entered official life through the jinshi examination in 793, but political conflict repeatedly displaced him from the center. Provincial service and banishment became part of the conditions in which he wrote. His poetry draws energy from folk literary forms, bringing cultivated composition into conversation with songs and voices beyond courtly circles. He also wrote philosophical prose, including discussions of Heaven that place him within the intellectual arguments of the Tang. His association with other exiled writers helps connect individual poems to networks of friendship and office. These works preserve a continuing capacity for response, rather than a career defined only by exclusion from the capital.
summary.zh: 刘禹锡于793年进士及第，进入仕途，政治冲突却多次使他离开权力中心。地方任职与贬谪成为写作的生活条件。他的诗歌吸收民间文学形式，使文人创作与宫廷圈子以外的歌声相联系；哲学散文则通过对“天”等问题的讨论，参与唐代思想论辩。与其他贬谪文人的交往，也使具体诗作可以放回友情和官职构成的网络。作品呈现的是持续回应生活的能力，而不只是一条被都城排斥的仕途。

title.en: Wang Yangming: moral knowledge tested in action
title.zh: 王阳明：在行动中检验道德认识

location.label: Guizhou, representative setting of exile and reflection

labelI18n.en: Guizhou, representative setting of exile and reflection
labelI18n.zh: 贵州，贬谪与思考的代表地区

summary.en: Wang Yangming, also known as Wang Shouren, passed the highest civil examination in 1499. Punishment in 1506 sent him toward exile in Guizhou, where the insight associated with 1508 became a turning point in his philosophical account. He argued that moral knowing was not merely information stored before action: genuine understanding and conduct belonged together. His emphasis on innate moral awareness also challenged a learning practice centered only on accumulating external knowledge. Return to office brought military and administrative responsibilities, keeping his philosophy close to questions of public action. The resulting tradition asks a practical question: what does someone truly know if that knowledge leaves their conduct untouched?
summary.zh: 王阳明本名王守仁，1499年通过最高级文官考试。1506年受罚后，他被贬往贵州；与1508年相联系的悟道，成为其思想历程的转折。他主张道德认识并非行动前储存的一套信息，真实理解与行为本来相连。对内在良知的重视，也挑战了只向外积累知识的学习方式。重返仕途后，军事和行政职责使其哲学持续接触公共行动的问题。由此形成的思想传统提出一个切实追问：如果某种知识丝毫不改变人的行为，究竟能说已经懂得了什么？

title.en: Gao Shi at the county desk

summary.en:
A county job brought Gao Shi close to the machinery of Tang government. Appointed to Fengqiu in 749, he described an office where even a small jurisdiction generated deadlines, formal greetings and punishments. His poem “Written at Fengqiu” turns from the humiliation of bowing before superiors to the distress of flogging ordinary people. At home, the speaker’s family laughs at the life he has acquired. The scene gives local administration a voice quite different from a court proclamation.

Gao left the post in 752 and later served on a frontier staff. Reading this episode beside Du Fu and Bai Juyi connects poetic ambition with the daily work of government. The poem offers a crafted account of an official’s discomfort; its force comes from bringing hierarchy, household conversation and the people subject to punishment into the same frame.
summary.zh:
749年，高适出任封丘县尉，进入唐代地方行政的日常。《封丘作》写小县也有繁多期限，要迎送上官，还要执行刑罚。诗人从向上司屈身的难堪，写到鞭打百姓的悲伤；回家诉说，家人却笑他如今的处境。县衙的权力关系、普通人的遭遇和家庭里的对话，就这样进入同一首诗。

高适于752年离职，后来进入边地幕府。把这段经历与杜甫、白居易的作品并读，可以看到文学志向怎样与治理事务相遇。诗中的官员带有作者经营的自我形象，并非县务档案；它仍让读者贴近地方官在等级、职责与同情之间感到的冲突。

dateNote.en: 749–752 marks the inspected chronology of the Fengqiu appointment and resignation. The poem is associated with the posting; no exact composition day is asserted.
dateNote.zh: 749—752年对应所核查的封丘任职与辞官时段。诗与这段任职经历相关，不指定确切写作日期。

title.en: Song textiles: household work and skilled workshops
title.zh: 宋代纺织：家庭劳动与专业作坊

summary.en:
Silk’s prestige can hide the many stages of labour that made cloth possible. Feeding silkworms, tending trays, handling cocoons and preparing thread required repeated household work, often performed by women. Complex patterned fabrics also depended on skilled professional weaving in official and private workshops. These tasks belonged to connected settings rather than one uniform factory system.

Most people did not dress exclusively in luxurious silk: hemp, ramie and, increasingly toward the end of the period, cotton also mattered. A painted sericulture handscroll offers a carefully composed image of production, not an unmediated record of every worker’s conditions. Reading it beside written accounts helps ask whose effort was celebrated, organized or left unnamed. The resulting history connects elite garments and traded goods to ordinary maintenance work, while allowing divisions of skill and gender to differ across households and workshops.
summary.zh:
丝织品的声望容易遮蔽成布之前的多重劳动。养蚕、清理蚕盘、处理蚕茧与准备丝线，需要反复进行的家庭工作，往往由女性承担。复杂花纹织物还依靠官营或私营作坊中的专业织工。这些工作属于相互联系的不同环境，并非统一的工厂体系。

多数人并不全穿华贵丝绸，麻、苎麻以及宋末日益重要的棉也参与日常衣着。蚕织画卷提供的是经过组织的生产图像，不是每位劳动者处境的直接记录。把画面与文字记载并读，有助于追问哪些劳动被赞颂、被组织，哪些劳动者没有留下姓名。这样的历史把精英服饰和贸易商品与普通日常维护连接起来，同时允许家庭和作坊中的技能、性别分工存在差异。

dateNote.en: Song-period focus, 960–1279. The representative point is not the origin of all fibres or a boundary for textile production.
dateNote.zh: 关注960—1279年的宋代；坐标既不是所有纤维的起源地，也不是纺织生产的边界。

title.en: Zhou: kings, lineages and competing states

summary.en: The Zhou replaced Shang rule and governed through relationships with aristocratic lineages. Bronze vessels recorded gifts, offices and ancestral claims, making ritual objects evidence of political authority. After the royal court moved east, regional rulers increasingly acted independently. Competition among these states changed warfare, administration and intellectual life. The long Zhou interval therefore contains very different political worlds: an early royal order and later fragmentation. Reading its objects alongside its chronology helps distinguish a dynasty’s continuing name from its changing ability to command other rulers.
summary.zh: 周取代商后，通过与贵族宗族的关系组织统治。青铜器铭文记录赏赐、官职和祖先功绩，礼器也因此成为政治权力的证据。王室东迁后，地方诸侯日益独立，列国竞争推动战争、行政与思想变化。漫长的周代包含早期王权与后期分裂等不同局面；王朝名称的延续，并不意味着控制力始终相同。

title.en: Xu Da · conquest and a continuing frontier
title.zh: 徐达 · 征服与持续的边疆战争

summary.en: Xu Da was one of Zhu Yuanzhang’s principal commanders in the wars that established Ming rule. In 1368 his army entered the Yuan capital, Dadu, after the emperor had withdrawn north. The Ming History emphasizes the securing of government stores and palace buildings, presenting disciplined occupation as part of his reputation. Yet the capture of a capital did not end the military contest. Xu fought Köke Temür near Dingxi in 1370 and suffered a serious defeat during another northern expedition in 1372. Seen together, these episodes show the difference between a dynastic turning point and the continued work of campaigning, garrisoning and defending a frontier against opponents who remained in the field.
summary.zh: 徐达是朱元璋建立明朝战争中的主要统帅之一。1368年，元帝北撤后，他率军进入元都大都。《明史》强调封存府库、保护宫殿等措施，把占领中的纪律写入他的形象。然而，夺取都城并未结束军事较量。1370年徐达在定西附近与扩廓帖木儿交战，1372年再次北征时又遭受严重失败。合看这些经历，可以区分王朝更替的转折点，与此后仍须进行的征战、驻防及应对继续抵抗者的边防工作。

title.en: Song money: paper promises and public authority
title.zh: 宋代货币：纸面信用与公共权力

labelI18n.zh: 成都；早期纸币背景的代表地点

summary.en:
Paper currency emerged from the practical difficulties of moving and paying large quantities of metal money. Merchant instruments and later government issues depended on acceptance, redemption arrangements and confidence in the issuer. Their history is therefore a story of commercial organization and public authority, not simply the discovery that writing a number on paper could replace coins.

Different kinds of money continued to coexist, and conditions varied between regions and periods. Later Yuan and Ming paper currencies extended the history without making their institutions identical to Song practices. A Ming note preserved in the British Museum expresses value through an image of coin strings, showing how paper could refer to older monetary forms. That object is a later comparison rather than a surviving Song note. Keeping these distinctions visible prevents a useful museum illustration from becoming false evidence for an earlier issue.
summary.zh:
纸币的出现，与大量金属货币运输和支付的不便有关。商人使用的凭券，以及后来的政府发行，都依赖接受范围、兑现安排和对发行者的信任。因此，这不仅是发现“在纸上写个数字就能代替钱”的故事，也涉及商业组织和公共权力。

不同货币继续并存，各地各时期的条件也不相同。元、明纸币延续了这一历史，却不意味着它们与宋代制度完全一致。大英博物馆保存的一张明代纸钞，用钱串图像表达价值，显示纸面货币如何援引旧有货币形式。这件实物只是较晚的比较材料，并非宋代遗钞。保持这些区别，可以避免把有用的博物馆图像误当作更早发行的直接证据。

dateNote.en: Approximate focus: eleventh-century development through the Song endpoint; not a claim that every region used one stable currency.
dateNote.zh: 约以十一世纪发展至宋代终结为关注范围；不表示各地使用同一种稳定货币。

title.en: Tusi institutions: local authority and imperial negotiation
title.zh: 土司制度：地方权力与帝国协商

summary.en:
Tusi institutions joined hereditary local leadership with appointments and recognition from imperial governments. The relationship could involve titles, obligations, jurisdiction and competing claims to authority. It was neither identical to direct county administration nor a single independent state with one boundary. Different places and periods require their own political histories.

The UNESCO grouping of Laosicheng, Tangya and Hailongtun preserves administrative, residential, ceremonial and defensive evidence. Layouts and building forms show interactions between local practices and imperial symbols. An official heritage narrative emphasizes connection and accommodation, but material combination alone does not prove that relations were always peaceful or consensual. Examining institutions alongside community experience helps explain both negotiated rule and unequal power. This entry supplies a regional framework for individual fortresses and campaigns without turning every monument into a separate dynasty or projecting present administrative categories backward unchanged.
summary.zh:
土司制度把世袭地方首领，与帝国政府的任命和承认联系起来。这种关系涉及名号、义务、司法权限和相互竞争的权威主张。它既不等同于直接的州县行政，也不是拥有单一边界的独立国家；不同地点与时期都需要各自的政治史。

老司城、唐崖和海龙屯组成的世界遗产，保存了行政、居住、仪式和防御方面的证据。布局与建筑形式显示地方实践同帝国符号之间的互动。官方遗产叙述强调联系和调适，但物质形式的结合本身，不能证明关系始终和平或出于一致同意。把制度与社区经验并读，才能同时解释协商统治与不平等权力。本条为具体城堡和战争提供区域框架，不把每处遗址变成一个王朝，也不把今天的行政类别原样投射到过去。

title.en: Wang Yangming: moral knowledge tested in action
title.zh: 王阳明：在行动中检验道德认识

location.label: Guizhou, representative setting of exile and reflection

labelI18n.en: Guizhou, representative setting of exile and reflection

summary.en: Wang Yangming, also known as Wang Shouren, passed the highest civil examination in 1499. Punishment in 1506 sent him toward exile in Guizhou, where the insight associated with 1508 became a turning point in his philosophical account. He argued that moral knowing was not merely information stored before action: genuine understanding and conduct belonged together. His emphasis on innate moral awareness also challenged a learning practice centered only on accumulating external knowledge. Return to office brought military and administrative responsibilities, keeping his philosophy close to questions of public action. The resulting tradition asks a practical question: what does someone truly know if that knowledge leaves their conduct untouched?
summary.zh: 王阳明本名王守仁，1499年通过最高级文官考试。1506年受罚后，他被贬往贵州；与1508年相联系的悟道，成为其思想历程的转折。他主张道德认识并非行动前储存的一套信息，真实理解与行为本来相连。对内在良知的重视，也挑战了只向外积累知识的学习方式。重返仕途后，军事和行政职责使其哲学持续接触公共行动的问题。由此形成的思想传统提出一个切实追问：如果某种知识丝毫不改变人的行为，究竟能说已经懂得了什么？

title.en: Song textiles: household work and skilled workshops
title.zh: 宋代纺织：家庭劳动与专业作坊

summary.en:
Silk’s prestige can hide the many stages of labour that made cloth possible. Feeding silkworms, tending trays, handling cocoons and preparing thread required repeated household work, often performed by women. Complex patterned fabrics also depended on skilled professional weaving in official and private workshops. These tasks belonged to connected settings rather than one uniform factory system.

Most people did not dress exclusively in luxurious silk: hemp, ramie and, increasingly toward the end of the period, cotton also mattered. A painted sericulture handscroll offers a carefully composed image of production, not an unmediated record of every worker’s conditions. Reading it beside written accounts helps ask whose effort was celebrated, organized or left unnamed. The resulting history connects elite garments and traded goods to ordinary maintenance work, while allowing divisions of skill and gender to differ across households and workshops.
summary.zh:
丝织品的声望容易遮蔽成布之前的多重劳动。养蚕、清理蚕盘、处理蚕茧与准备丝线，需要反复进行的家庭工作，往往由女性承担。复杂花纹织物还依靠官营或私营作坊中的专业织工。这些工作属于相互联系的不同环境，并非统一的工厂体系。

多数人并不全穿华贵丝绸，麻、苎麻以及宋末日益重要的棉也参与日常衣着。蚕织画卷提供的是经过组织的生产图像，不是每位劳动者处境的直接记录。把画面与文字记载并读，有助于追问哪些劳动被赞颂、被组织，哪些劳动者没有留下姓名。这样的历史把精英服饰和贸易商品与普通日常维护连接起来，同时允许家庭和作坊中的技能、性别分工存在差异。

Szechuan. He excelled at figure painting. In his later years his avocations were studying ancient inscriptions and seal script calligraphy. This long handscroll illustrates the poem Making Clothes by Hsieh Hui-lien (397-433), which relates a story of women making clothes for their men away at war. In somber black and white, the entire scroll is limned in light ink in the uncolored outline (pai-miao) method. The thirty-two women depicted here reflect T'ang (618-907) ideals of beauty with their rounded faces and figures and full gowns. title.en: Qianlong Emperor · collecting culture, controlling texts
title.zh: 乾隆帝 · 收藏文化与控制文本

summary.en: Qianlong succeeded his father in 1735 and ruled through an expanding court culture of collecting, commissioning and classification. Paintings, calligraphy, gardens and official compilations helped present the emperor as a judge of knowledge and taste. The enormous Siku Quanshu project preserved many texts, while the same court searched for writings it considered hostile to Manchu rule and ordered works altered or destroyed. Cultural patronage and censorship therefore belonged to the same exercise of authority. In 1793 Qianlong received the Macartney embassy but rejected its principal requests for changes to trade arrangements. He formally abdicated in 1796 while continuing to intervene in government, separating the transfer of an imperial title from the surrender of political power.
summary.zh: 乾隆于1735年继承父位，统治伴随着宫廷收藏、委托制作与知识分类的扩展。绘画、书法、园林和官修典籍，将皇帝呈现为学识与品味的裁定者。《四库全书》工程保存大量文本，同一朝廷也搜查被认为敌视满洲统治的著作，命令删改或销毁。文化赞助与文字审查因此属于同一种权力运作。1793年乾隆接见马戛尔尼使团，却拒绝其改变贸易安排的主要要求。1796年他正式退位，仍继续干预政务，皇位名号的移交并不等于政治权力的交出。

（緙絲乾隆十全記）十全記。昨准廓爾喀歸降。命凱旋班師。詩有十全大武揚之句。蓋引而未發。茲特敘而記之。夫記者志也。虞書。朕志先定。乃在心。周禮。春官掌邦國之志。乃在事。旅獒志以道寧。則兼心與事而言之。然總不出夫道。得其道。乃能合於天。以冀承乎貺。則予之十全武功。庶幾有契於斯。而可志以記之乎。十功者。平準噶爾為二。定回部為一。掃金川為二。靖臺灣為一。降緬甸安南各一。即今之受廓爾喀降。合為十。其內地之三叛么膺。弗屑數也。平準噶爾者二。乙亥年以達瓦齊篡奪。諸部瓦解。朕因其部落接踵內屬。乘機致討。以成前志。未半載。遂俘達瓦齊。不意阿睦爾撒納潛逃。欲占伊犁。於是復命進剿逆賊。竄入俄羅斯。以患痘身斃。俄羅斯傳送其屍。伊犁遂平。定回部者一。當大兵西伐。時逆回小和卓木。背恩反覆。因命兆惠等統兵追剿。傳檄拔達克山縛獻。於是其弟兄大小和卓木一擒一斃。掃金川者二。先是金川娑羅奔。搆釁鄰番。戊辰歲。命傅恆厚集諸路官兵。將擣其中堅。而逆酋稽首請降。至壬辰。兩金川聯結作亂。命阿桂統師進剿。至丙申遂平其全境。靖臺灣者一。丁未逆民林爽文莊大田。創立天地會名目。煽誘匪徒。謀為不軌。命福康安海蘭察等統兵過海。將二逆悉行擒獲就誅。降緬甸者一。因緬匪侵擾邊境。命傅恆為經略前往。屢破賊壘。而彼即詣營請降。因而罷師。至戊申。其國長孟隕奉表入貢。乞恕前罪。遂允其請。降安南者一。初黎維祁為阮光平所侵。命孫士毅統兵。為之克復。黎城復封。黎維祁為王。乃阮光平再至。而黎維祁即棄國奔內地。更命福康安前往剿除。而阮光平備陳情事。再四籲懇乞降。並請於庚戌年親來瞻覲祝釐。朕既先有天厭黎氏之語。而安南又無人可付。亦即允其歸降。凡此八次。用兵皆非得已而俱荷。天佑成功。今并此廓爾喀兩次降順。蓋已十蕆大功。我武既揚。實屬厚幸。至於誅王倫。翦蘇四十三。滅田五三事。則係內地亂民。旋即討平。弗薌其事。兹故不列於武功云。前已酉廓爾喀之降。蓋因彼擾藏邊界。發偏師以問罪。而所遣鄂輝等未宣我武。巴忠乃遷就完事。致彼弗懼。而去歲復來。以至大掠後藏。飽欲而歸。使長此以往。彼將占藏地。嚇眾番。全蜀無寧歲矣。戊申歲廓爾喀滋事之始。命鄂輝成德。統率勁旅往剿彼時。因巴忠素曉唐古特語。令往會同籌辦。詎意巴忠諸事擅專。竟與噶布倫丹津班珠爾等。私同沙瑪爾巴定議。每歲令歲中許給廓爾喀元寶三百箇。退還侵地。並立大小合同二紙。鄂輝成德為其所愚。隨同附和。未曾示以兵威。是以廓爾喀去歲復敢侵擾。既將丹津班珠爾等裹去為質。並搶掠札什倫布廟財物。披猖已極。不得不命將興師。聲罪致討。且廓爾喀年來侵佔附近部落。兼并巴勒布三部。與後藏之聶拉木濟嚨宗喀等處毗連。不大加懲創。必至搶佔前後藏地。蜀中打箭鑪一帶將無寧歲矣。是以罪庸臣。選名將。勵眾軍。籌儲餉。去秋於木蘭圍場中。聞廓爾喀復來侵擾之信。朕謂不過與唐古特因錢債起釁。初未有發兵之意。而已忠一聞此事。旋即自戕。始疑此事必有弊端。諭令鄂輝查奏。始知有許銀贖地之事。駐藏大臣俘習渾。當廓爾喀搶掠之時。既不帶兵剿殺。又欲將班禪額爾德尼及達賴喇嘛移駐泰寧等處。幸而達賴喇嘛未從其言。是竟欲委棄藏地。本應即行正法。念其父那木札爾曾經陣亡。從寬令於藏地枷責。雅滿泰同係駐藏大臣。得習渾之奏。竟與聯銜因令一併枷責。以示嚴懲。旋念事關重大。福康安謀勇素著。足堪倚任。因命同海蘭察等。率領巴圖魯。侍衛章京。及索倫屯。疏兵丁前往。大張撻伐。福康安自擦木進兵之後。連次克捷。隨時褒賞。軍糧軍械尤為緊要。去冬即命孫士毅馳往籌辦。今春更命和琳馳抵藏中辦理。其濟嚨以外。令惠齡往來專司趲運。數月以來。宵旰籌謀。實未嘗一刻置懷也。福康安等深感朕恩。弗辭勞苦。於去歲冬月。即率索倫四川降番等精兵。次第由西寧冒雪而進。今歲五月。遂臨賊境。收復藏邊。攻克賊疆。履線險如平地。渡溜要若蹄涔。繞上襲下。埋根批吭。手足胼胝。有所弗恤。七戰七勝。賊人喪膽。福康安等到藏於今歲閏四月廿七日。自第哩浪古帶兵起程。五月初六日至擦木地方。即乘陰雨。連夜發兵。分隊進討海蘭察等。由正路直攻賊寨。福康安督率官兵。攻克碉座。賊人即已驚怖。初八日行抵瑪噶爾。轄爾甲地方。峭壁深林。內藏賊匪三百餘名。官兵擊殺數十名。福康安又派兵埋伏半山。故留一路。誘賊上山。及山半帶兵橫衝。賊眾奔竄。直追至邦杏地方。沿途剿殺無算。初九日直抵濟嚨官寨。分遣兵丁攻撲。使賊人處處受敵。不能相顧。初十日丑刻。同時並進。搶上東南山梁。攻得喇嘛寺。屯聚賊匪又將石砌碉座立時焚燬。官兵等冒雨攻圍。殲戮賊眾殆盡。亥刻遂攻破官寨。藏地全復。十五日至熱索橋。過此即屬賊境。福康安等一面遣兵。由上游峩綠山下。扎筏徑渡。直撲賊卡。而正路官兵。乘勝搭橋。一時並濟將士。無不人人奮勇。痛加剿殺。十七日復行前進。深入賊境一百六七十里。地名協布魯。該處當路有橫河一道。水深溜急。而橋座賊已拆毀。福康安等於二十三日帶兵繞至橫河上游。借接枯樹搭橋。賊匪鎗聲不絕。因於日暮大雨時。佯令各兵徹退。至夜半。賊匪回寨。趕緊接縛大木過河。分為三路。於二十四日黎明。併力壓下。盡行焚燬賊寨。痛殲賊眾。二十四日攻克協布魯後。自噶多正路至足木古拉巴載山梁山下。有橫河一道。對面大山。即係東覺。福康安與海蘭察分為兩路。福康安探得上游噶多普山上樹木茂密。可以藏身。因繞行。於六月初六日下至山麓鳧水渡河。官兵奮勇剿殺。將近河碉卡木城。盡行奪據。而海蘭察亦連日潛伏。冒雨步行。初六日黎明徑登博爾東拉山巔。繞至賊卡之上。將木城石卡全行拆毀。旋與福康安會合一處。併力追剿。於初九日至雍鴉地方。因官兵等冒險登陟。辛勤已甚。暫令休息。而賊酋遣人乞降。經福康安嚴行駁飭。惟是該處大山層疊而堆補木。與甲爾古拉兩山之間又有橫河一道。福康安等將官兵分為數隊。左一路由橫河上游繞道進攻。右一路由帕朗古攻橋進撲。甲爾古拉賊匪。排鎗連環不斷。我兵乘勢競進。奪據橋座。剿殺更倍於前。計自擦木邦杏濟嚨熱索橋協布魯東覺帕朗古前後。凡七戰皆獲全勝。共殺賊目二十餘名。賊匪三四千名。生擒二百餘名。雖山徑險仄。河溜湍急。福康安等鼓勇直前。如履平地。如渡蹄涔。賊勢甚為窮蹙。前已屢遣頭人詣營納款。至此次益加震讋。哀懇乞降。無不惟命是從矣。及兵臨陽布。賊遂屢遣頭人。匍匐乞降。將軍所檄事件。無不謹從。而獨不敢身詣軍營。蓋彼去歲誘藏之噶布倫丹津班珠爾等前去。故不敢出也。賊人經官兵屢戰屢勝之後。其力實不能支。卑辭乞命。心膽俱落。凡福康安等檄諭之事。無不一一遵奉。先將裹去之噶布倫丹津班珠爾等送出。繼又將上冬搶去扎什倫布廟之金銀器皿。悉數繳還。並沙瑪爾巴骨殖及前私立合同二張。亦俱呈出。不敢再提唐古特錢債一事。且言從前為沙瑪爾巴所唆。實已悔之無及。惟乞大皇帝憐憫全部生靈。網開一面。其畏懼情形。似屬真誠。其賊酋拉特納巴都爾與其叔巴都爾薩野。不敢親自來營。自謂從前誘裹噶布倫等一事。罪惡已極。懼于擒戮。故不敢出此。亦真情。無怪其然也。我武既揚。必期掃穴犁庭。不遺一介。亦非體上天好生之意。即使盡得其地。而西藏邊外又數千里之遙。所謂不可耕而守者。亦將付之他人。乃降旨允降班師。以蕆斯事。昔唐太宗策頡利曰。示之必克。其和乃固。廓爾喀非頡利之比。番邊殊長安之近。彼且乞命籲恩。准之不暇。又安敢言和乎。然今日之宣兵威。使賊固意求降歸順。實與唐太宗之論有所符合。昔予記土爾扈特之事。於歸降歸順。已悉言之。若今廓爾喀之謝罪乞命。歸降歸順。蓋並有焉。以其悔過。誠而獻地。切也。向著土爾扈特歸順記云。始逆命而終徠服。謂之歸降。弗加征而自臣屬。謂之歸順。言土爾扈特之投誠。乃歸順。非歸降也。若今之廓爾喀畏威悔罪。雖屬歸降。然其悔罪之意極為真摯。並請定期五年一貢。永遵約束。又將邊外扎木地方獻歸西藏。是則誠心嚮化。不但歸降而且歸順矣。迺知守中國者。不可徒言偃武修文以自示弱也。彼偃武修文之不已。必致棄其故有而不能守。是亦不可不知耳。知進知退。易有明言。予實服膺不敢忘。每於用武之際。更切深思。定於志以合乎道。幸而五十七年之間。十全武功。豈非天貺。然天貺愈深。予懼益切。不敢言感。惟恐難承。兢兢惶惶。以俟天眷。為歸政全人。夫復何言。乾隆壬子季秋御筆。（緙印二）。八徵耄念之寶。自彊不息。 title.en: Zhu Yuanzhang: rebuilding institutions and concentrating authority
title.zh: 朱元璋：重建制度与集中权力

summary.en: Zhu Yuanzhang founded the Ming in 1368 and pursued a government that reached from the emperor’s court into village registration and local schools. Early measures established county granaries and promoted Confucian education. The lijia system introduced in 1381 organized households for administrative obligations, making local communities part of the state’s machinery. These institution-building projects accompanied an increasingly concentrated form of rule. The purge of Hu Weiyong in 1380 and the abolition of the chief minister’s position drew more decisions toward the emperor. His reign therefore links rebuilding after dynastic conflict with coercion and political suspicion. Schools and registers tell one part of that story; the destruction of officials and their networks tells another.
summary.zh: 朱元璋1368年建立明朝，推动一种从皇帝朝廷延伸到乡村登记和地方学校的治理。早期措施兴设县级粮仓、推广儒学教育；1381年实行的里甲制度，把户籍与行政义务组织起来，使地方社区进入国家运转体系。这些制度营建伴随权力进一步集中。1380年胡惟庸案及丞相职位的废除，使更多决策直接归于皇帝。他的统治把王朝战乱后的重建与强制、政治猜忌联系起来：学校和簿册讲述其中一面，官员及其关系网络遭摧毁又呈现另一面。

title.en: Tusi institutions: local authority and imperial negotiation
title.zh: 土司制度：地方权力与帝国协商

summary.en:
Tusi institutions joined hereditary local leadership with appointments and recognition from imperial governments. The relationship could involve titles, obligations, jurisdiction and competing claims to authority. It was neither identical to direct county administration nor a single independent state with one boundary. Different places and periods require their own political histories.

The UNESCO grouping of Laosicheng, Tangya and Hailongtun preserves administrative, residential, ceremonial and defensive evidence. Layouts and building forms show interactions between local practices and imperial symbols. An official heritage narrative emphasizes connection and accommodation, but material combination alone does not prove that relations were always peaceful or consensual. Examining institutions alongside community experience helps explain both negotiated rule and unequal power. This entry supplies a regional framework for individual fortresses and campaigns without turning every monument into a separate dynasty or projecting present administrative categories backward unchanged.
summary.zh:
土司制度把世袭地方首领，与帝国政府的任命和承认联系起来。这种关系涉及名号、义务、司法权限和相互竞争的权威主张。它既不等同于直接的州县行政，也不是拥有单一边界的独立国家；不同地点与时期都需要各自的政治史。

老司城、唐崖和海龙屯组成的世界遗产，保存了行政、居住、仪式和防御方面的证据。布局与建筑形式显示地方实践同帝国符号之间的互动。官方遗产叙述强调联系和调适，但物质形式的结合本身，不能证明关系始终和平或出于一致同意。把制度与社区经验并读，才能同时解释协商统治与不平等权力。本条为具体城堡和战争提供区域框架，不把每处遗址变成一个王朝，也不把今天的行政类别原样投射到过去。

dateNote.en: Approximate thirteenth–nineteenth-century institutional focus; the official dossier extends into the early twentieth century. No common founding/end date or territorial polygon is asserted.
dateNote.zh: 约关注十三至十九世纪的制度；官方档案还涉及二十世纪初。不主张统一起止年或共同领土边界。

context.en: The portrait and facing biography frame Liu Yuxi as a poet worth remembering in Qing China.
context.zh: 肖像与对页传记呈现清代对刘禹锡这位唐代诗人的追忆。

context.en: The philosopher also practiced painting and calligraphy. The museum identifies Ni Zan’s influence in this quiet composition, expanding the biography beyond Wang’s teaching and public career.
context.zh: 这位思想家亦从事书画；馆方指出宁静构图受到倪瓒影响，使其生平不止于讲学与政治活动。

context.en: The heading explicitly announces completion of the two Jinchuan campaigns. Its formal praise records the court’s celebration of military success and should be read as a partisan voice.
context.zh: 题首明确写“平定两金川大功告成”；颂词记录宫廷如何庆祝战事，应作为具有立场的当时声音阅读。

context.en: The label identifies Gao Shi, the poet in the Fengqiu officeholding story. This imagined assembly of Tang scholars shows his later reputation, not an actual shared journey or the county appointment.
context.zh: 题名明确辨识封丘任职故事中的高适；唐代文士的想象聚会表现后世声望，并非真实同行或县尉任命场景。

context.en: The box inscription traces this conch from imperial ritual to Fuk’anggan’s Taiwan voyage and back to court.
context.zh: 原匣题记串起这件法螺从宫廷仪式、随福康安渡海赴台，到返回宫廷的经历。

context.en: Buildings, trays and workers organize silk production into household spaces. Follow how the painter connects separate tasks.
context.zh: 建筑、器具与劳动者把蚕织生产安排在家庭空间中。观察画家如何连接不同工序。

context.en: This is one of the inscribed ritual vessels central to the Zhou entry’s account of offices and political authority. The exterior photograph shows the vessel’s form; the inscription is transcribed on the linked museum page.
context.zh: 此器正是周代条目所述通过铭文记述官职与政治权力的礼器实例；外观照片展示器形，馆藏链接提供铭文内容。

context.en: The emperor shares sacrificial meat with Xu Da after praying for crops. This direct address presents the sovereign–commander relationship through a ritual gift.
context.zh: 皇帝祈谷后与徐达分享祭肉；直接称名的敕书，通过礼仪馈赠呈现君臣关系。

context.en: Metal cash remained important alongside paper instruments. This surviving Song coin supplies a contemporary material comparison for the entry’s discussion of moving, paying and representing monetary value.
context.zh: 金属钱与纸面凭券并存；这枚宋钱为条目所述货币运输、支付与价值表达提供当时实物参照。

context.en: The text responds to a local An chief’s rebuilding of a shrine and discusses moral transformation. It offers a Ming scholar’s voice within negotiations between hereditary local authority and imperial cultural ideals.
context.zh: 文字回应安氏宣慰重修祠宇，并讨论教化；在世袭地方权力与帝国文化理想的互动中，留下明代士人的声音。

context.en: Scissors, fabric and a shared workspace connect this poetic scene to the textile story’s stages of garment making.

context.en: Imperial writing became a costly crafted object. The textile connects Qianlong’s collecting and commissioning to the presentation of his military record as perfect achievement, a claim made by the emperor.

context.en: The solitary rider carries Jinchuan victory news through a mountainous landscape. The painting makes the movement of military information its subject.
context.zh: 独骑在山地传递金川捷报；画卷以军事消息的流动为观看焦点。

title.en: Fuk’anggan reaches Taiwan; Zhuluo is renamed Jiayi
title.zh: 福康安赴台作战，诸罗改名嘉义

summary.en: In 1787, Fuk’anggan crossed to Taiwan during the Lin Shuangwen uprising. The Qing court renamed Zhuluo as Jiayi in recognition of the town’s defenders. Fighting continued into 1788. A conch sent with the commander preserves a box inscription recording its 1787 dispatch and 1788 return to the court.
summary.zh: 1787年，福康安在林爽文事件期间渡海赴台作战。清廷为褒奖诸罗守城者，将县名改为嘉义；战事延续至1788年。随统帅出行的法螺，其匣签记下1787年赐发、1788年缴回宫廷的经历。

dateNote.en: 1787 anchors the commander’s arrival and county renaming; the campaign ended in 1788. The map point represents Jiayi.
dateNote.zh: 1787年指统帅抵台与县名更改；战事结束于1788年。地图点代表嘉义。

note.en: Separated the 1787 arrival and renaming from the 1788 campaign endpoint, using museum chronology, the institutional historical map and the conch inscription.
note.zh: 据博物馆展览说明、学术机构历史地图及法螺匣签，分开1787年抵台、改名与1788年战事终结。
